## Miniaturizing Mimic (CR 3)

This innocuous music box plays an enchanting melody of its own accord before snapping at the hand that reaches for it.  

**XP** 800  
N Tiny aberration (shapechanger)  
**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +7  
**Aura** diminishment (DC 14)  


**Defense**


**AC** 18, touch 14, flat-footed 16 (+2 Dex, +4 natural, +2 size)  
**hp** 22 (4d8+4)  
**Fort** +1, **Ref** +3, **Will** +4  
**Immune** acid, bardic masterpieces and performances, language-dependent effects, sonic  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft.  
**Melee** bite +7 (1d3-1 plus curse of diminishment and grab)  
**Space** 2-1/2 ft.; **Reach** 0 ft.  
**Special Attacks** bardic performance 6 rounds/day (countersong, distraction, fascinate [DC 14]), diminishing swallow whole (1d3-1 bludgeoning plus 1d6 acid damage, AC 12, hp 18)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 4th; concentration +6)  


At will—ghost sound (DC 12)  

1/day—hold person (DC 14), suggestion (DC 14)  



**Tactics**


**Before Combat** The minuscule mimic uses ghost sound (if imitating a music box) or suggestion to entice creatures to pick it up.  

**During Combat** The minuscule mimic attempts to shrink opponents with its diminishment ability, then swallow them whole for later digestion.  

**Morale** The minuscule mimic attempts to flee if it is in danger of being captured or if its enemies seem resistant to its curse.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 9, **Dex** 15, **Con** 12, **Int** 10, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 14  
**Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +2 (+6 grapple); **CMD** 10  
**Feats** [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Agile Maneuvers and Weapon Finesse are one feat, Weapon Finesse; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
**Skills** Climb +9, Disguise +9 (+29 when mimicking objects), Perception +7, Stealth +17; Racial Modifiers +20 Disguise when mimicking objects  
**Languages** Common  
**SQ** mimic object  


**Special Abilities**


**Aura of Diminishment (Su)** Miniaturizing mimics unleash a mesmerizing melody that causes creatures who hear them to shrink in size. Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of a miniaturizing mimic is affected by its curse of diminishment (see below) unless it succeeds on a DC 14 Will save. This aura is a sonic mind-affecting effect, and the miniaturizing mimic can activate or suppress its aura at will as a move action.  

**Curse of Diminishment (Su)** Bite—contact; *save* Fort DC 14, frequency 1/round; *effect* Target becomes a Microsized creature and is reduced in size by 1d4 size categories, to a minimum size of Fine. Multiple failed saves stack this size reduction, to a minimum size of Fine. The target’s weapons, armor, and gear that it wields or carries is similarly reduced in size. The save DC is Charisma-based. If a cursed target is subjected to the curse of diminishment again and fails its saving throw, it immediately reduces in size by one additional size category. Removing the curse stops the target from shrinking further, but it doesn’t return them to their true size. Once the curse has been removed, the creature can attempt a new DC 14 Fortitude save each day to regrow one size category. Once the creature has been returned to its normal size, it is no longer a Microsized creature.  

**Mimic Object (Ex)** A miniaturizing mimic can assume the general shape of any Tiny object, such as a jewelry box, a music box, or a figurine. The creature cannot substantially alter its size, though. A minuscule mimic’s body is hard and has a rough texture, no matter what appearance it might present. A mimic gains a +20 racial bonus on Disguise checks when imitating an object in this manner. Disguise is always a class skill for a minuscule mimic.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any urban  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** incidental
